2025-05-13.riddle: I break but never bleed or cry, I spill my guts when dropped nearby. I’m fragile, round, and found in kitchens— What am I?
2025-05-13.hint: I am often eaten for breakfast.

2025-05-14.riddle: I stretch from wall to glowing wall, You flip a switch—I light it all. I brighten rooms and chase out night— What am I?
2025-05-14.hint: This small object lights up when powered and is often found in lamps or ceilings.

2025-05-15.riddle: What word is spelled incorrectly in every dictionary?
2025-05-15.hint: Sometimes, the answer is hiding right in front of you… literally.

2025-05-16.riddle: I hang on walls to show the day, With boxes neat in full display. You flip my page when months go by— What am I?
2025-05-16.hint: You check me to see the date, plan events, or count down the days. I'm usually on a wall or a desk.

2025-05-17.riddle: I snap a shot but have no hands, I see the world in distant lands. I save your smiles, freeze your face— What am I?
2025-05-17.hint: It captures moments in still images or video, often used on vacations or at celebrations.

2025-05-18.riddle: I go up high with strings attached, In sky-blue games, I’m often matched. The wind’s my friend, I love to glide— What am I?
2025-05-18.hint: It dances in the wind, often flown by kids in open fields or on beaches, attached to a string held from below.

2025-05-19.riddle: I wake you up with beeps or bells, I keep you on time, as stories tell. You set me nightly near your bed— What am I?
2025-05-19.hint: It sits by your bedside and makes noise when it’s time to get up—especially early in the morning.
